adjudication.evidence: Both P1 and P2 span the same physical event (J1–J2 onset at ~576, J3–J4 return at ~622), but their intervals overlap and neither fully captures the sustained platform: original N/E/U show a clear step up at ~576, a stable elevated plateau until ~621–622, then a sharp drop back. The residual plots confirm that subtracting either candidate’s offset leaves a persistent offset in the plateau region, indicating incomplete correction; only a single nonoverlapping range covering ~576–622 matches the sustained shift-and-return pattern across all axes. Missing samples (e.g., 613, 629) do not disrupt the plateau continuity.
